Complete creation block 54288879 to finalized-pin history spans 27 contiguous million-block pages and only these two peers; both PeerSet logs have successful canonical receipt/header proofs. Nonzero supply is 945006706000000000000 raw share units, and the Ethereum source outbound nonce is 2. Whole runtime hex-text SHA256 e1a4bcd29f7d6d33bb4375fc63b6ba9e7a4e8f180aab27355c63a40f411b3c59 equals the live and Sourcify-verified MegaETH wiTRYOFT runtime.
